The Stop-1 direction note (ARC_MICA-DESIGN_Gate2-Tier1-LongRunA-Stop1-Direction_20261015) F-1..F-13, §7 the shapes, §9 the claim-must-fail cases. MECHANISM (the narrow design, contract M2): items are matched by the pointer's target fingerprint (witnessed.cites.targetFingerprint) against the item fingerprints the bridge computes in its current salt epoch; origin(r) = the declared origin whose subject is r.moduleId, else UNRESOLVED; differs(r) reads witnessed.observed, NEVER the outcome (the outcome hides the facet behind HELD/LATE); damage(r) = item ∧ differs ∧ origin resolved ∧ origin ∉ grants[item], whatever the fate; cleared(r) = r.hash ∈ clearances. ALARM ⇔ ∃ damage ∧ ¬cleared over the current book and every readable predecessor (latch only), re-derived at every read (nothing persisted; the book is the durable record). Otherwise the carried act — the newest roster act (the interest book, since the book's boundary) before the deciding act — is read from its own record: none → G2_NOT_READABLE ('NOT READABLE:' first, with the reason: the frame's DECLARED underived word (config.underivedWord, never a literal in the reader) matching the act's label, or otherwise no record, the label quoted); off-basket, granted DIFFERS, cleared DIFFERS, or SAME/FIRST_SEEN at a RAN act → SILENT; UNOBSERVABLE or HELD/LATE without a DIFFERS → G2_UNKNOWN_ON_ITEM; an unresolved origin → G2_ORIGIN_NOT_READABLE. Membership needs the bridge's salt epoch and a book begun inside it (G2_MEMBERSHIP_NOT_READABLE); an unreadable or pre-epoch predecessor is named and blocks SILENT (never an ALARM). A RECORDER prints on every harm verdict (method classes, facet × category, records on items, roster acts with/without a record, unknowns on items, predecessors named and never summed).
